name: Replicate
description: Search and run Replicate models (image generation and editing, upscaling, background removal, video, lip-sync, speech, music, stems, sound effects, 3D, transcription) with your own Replicate API token. Outputs are saved to the library.

models.title: Model tools
models.description: Comma-separated Replicate models (owner/name) that get their own typed tool. Their schemas are fetched once with your token and cached. Leave empty for none.

cache_ttl_hours.title: Catalog cache (hours)
cache_ttl_hours.description: How long model search results and schemas are cached on disk.

max_wait_minutes.title: Max wait (minutes)
max_wait_minutes.description: After this long the call stops waiting and asks Replicate to cancel the prediction (a Cancel-After header is also sent as a backstop); the error says whether the cancel was accepted and how to collect the prediction later.

allow_url_inputs.title: Allow URL file inputs
allow_url_inputs.description: Let model file inputs be https URLs. The provider fetches them, so anything in the link is shared with it. Off: library artifacts only ("artifact:<id>").
